risks_written_before: (1) gen_045 already learned from E4-style labels for 45 generations (15% reanalysis mix): its val value loss on the E5o buffer is 0.307 at step 0 against 0.604 for taraguchi_v1 in E4, so the room left is smaller and the effect may be below what 120 pairs can show (about 0.10); INCONCLUSIVE is a likely and valid outcome. (2) Pela 2023 and Yixin 2018 are both training-game opponents and A/B opponents (openings differ), so a gain may be opponent-specific. (3) Round 2 reuses the same 120 training openings. (4) The fine-tune has no self-play after it, so policy/opening heads are only held by the replay batch.
stops: any DojoZero failure in the training games, a training non-finite gradient, a labelling or build error stop the step before the next A/B; a stopped run is reported as stopped. No extra pairs or reruns based on an A/B result.
